pin.title: Global Alarm PIN/Code
pin.description: Your global system alarm PIN. Please Note: The PIN must be exactly 4 digits, 0–9.

changePartition.title: Multi-partition system, automatically change partition(s)
changePartition.description: A partition is a sectioned-off portion of an alarm system that can be operated independently of the rest of the system. This option automatically changes to the specific partition before executing an alarm command. This is not needed for a non-partitioned system. This option slightly increases panel command execution time.

openZoneTimeout.title: Zone timeout in seconds
openZoneTimeout.description: Length of time to wait before a zone is considered closed. Default: 30 seconds. Warning: Setting this value too low can cause zones to clear and fault unexpectedly.

heartbeatInterval.title: Heartbeat interval in seconds
heartbeatInterval.description: Heartbeat interval to check for a disconnected Envisalink session. Default: 30 seconds. Note: Values below 30 seconds may cause hung sessions to be identified incorrectly.

commandTimeOut.title: Command timeout in seconds
commandTimeOut.description: Length of time to wait for an alarm command to return. Bypass commands automatically triple this value because those operations take longer. Default: 10 seconds.

autoReconnect.title: Automatically reconnect to Envisalink server
autoReconnect.description: Automatically reconnect to the Envisalink server if the session is terminated.

sessionWatcher.title: Enable session watcher for Envisalink server
sessionWatcher.description: Enable the session watcher to detect dropped connections. The heartbeat value determines the interval for checking the connection.

chimeToggle.title: Display a switch in HomeKit to toggle the chime sound on/off
chimeToggle.description: Create a switch in HomeKit to turn the chime sound on the Ademco panel on or off.

batteryRunTime.title: Expected runtime of battery backup
batteryRunTime.description: Runtime of the battery backup, in hours.

envisalinkFailureSuppress.title: Turn off Envisalink module alarm tamper events
envisalinkFailureSuppress.description: Turn off alarm tamper events associated with Envisalink module communication errors. Note: These errors are still logged in Homebridge.

ignoreFireTrouble.title: Allow alarm arming when in Fire trouble state.
ignoreFireTrouble.description: When the virtual keypad sends a fire trouble signal, treat it as a warning and allow arming.

ignoreSystemTrouble.title: Allow alarm arming when in System trouble state.
ignoreSystemTrouble.description: When the virtual keypad sends a system trouble signal, treat it as a warning and allow arming.

maintenanceMode.title: Disable connection to Envisalink module for maintenance
maintenanceMode.description: Place the plugin in maintenance mode to allow testing and/or replacement of the Envisalink module without affecting existing automations or filling the logs with error messages. WARNING: This disables all updates and operations.

proxyEnabled.title: Allow sharing of Envisalink TPI connection
proxyEnabled.description: Allow the Envisalink TPI connection to be shared with two other clients. Because the connection to the Envisalink server is shared, a secondary TPI client can cause this plugin to malfunction.

partitionNumber.title: Number
partitionNumber.description: Direct management of a specific partition number. Note: Not needed for non-partitioned systems.

partitionPin.title: Partition PIN/Code
partitionPin.description: Use when arming with a non-global PIN. Please Note: The PIN must be exactly 4 digits, 0–9. This value overrides the global PIN for this partition.

zones.description: Alarm zones to monitor, manage and display in HomeKit

bypassEnabled.title: Zone Bypass Enabled
bypassEnabled.description: Allow this zone to be bypassed from HomeKit.

bypass.description: Display a switch for bypassing zones that are being monitored.

enabledbyPass.title: Display a switch in HomeKit to enable and disable zone bypass

zoneMemory.title: Remember bypassed zones
zoneMemory.description: Allow the plugin to remember which zones were bypassed and restore them after disarming. This also enables individual zone bypasses to be toggled on and off.

probeZone.title: Bypass probe zone number
probeZone.description: Upon startup and after any change in bypass state, the plugin uses this zone to trigger the panel to list the currently open zones. Note: Verify that this zone is not wired on your panel to ensure this does not cause problems.

customcommand.title: Custom macro command
customcommand.description: For a custom macro, provide the command string to send to the alarm panel. The escape string @pin is replaced with the master PIN/code.

items.title: Zone Bypass
items.description: Display a HomeKit switch for bypassing zones that are being monitored.

items.title: Speed Key (Macro) keys
items.description: These keys (A, B, C, and/or D) are usually on the left side of the alarm keypad. They execute pre-stored automated sequences in the system's memory, or you can enter a custom automated input sequence that imitates keypad input. Each key name must be unique.

items.title: Bypassed Zones Memory
items.description: Enable bypassed zones memory, which allows the plugin to remember which zones were bypassed and restore them after disarming. This also enables individual zone bypasses to be toggled on and off.
